Dialog.Title: Mount
Dialog.ImageHint: Saved for this combination and suggested next time.

Chat.Cost: Costs half of your own speed ({cost} {units}).

Notify.NoGM: A Game Master must be online to mount or dismount.

Range.Name: Maximum distance (squares)
Range.Hint: How far apart rider and mount may be. 0 = adjacent. The GM is not bound by this when mounting.

SizeRule.Name: Mount must be larger
SizeRule.Hint: By 5e rules the mount must be at least one size category larger than the rider.

ChatMessage.Name: Chat message on mount/dismount
ChatMessage.Hint: Posts who mounts or dismounts and reminds of the cost (half speed).
